purpose: Source-only Bluetooth/external-mic route and recording-recovery preflight, not a device result
timing_basis: Synthetic Date offsets in milliseconds; no wall-clock modification, real-time waiting, latency measurement or 2-second recovery SLA.

reference_utterance.spoken_text: Audio sample thirty-two. Check label seven first; do not submit or overwrite the original.
reference_utterance.ideal_verbatim_text: Audio sample thirty-two. Check label seven first; do not submit or overwrite the original.
reference_utterance.human_review: Check32,7 and both negations; actual output unknown, never stitch a fictional complete capture.

virtual_input_formats.disclaimer: Illustrative values only, not accessory specifications, measured formats or forced settings.

virtual_route_aliases.comparison: Recorder compares sorted current input UIDs. Aliases are not actual UIDs, product names or selectable inputs.

debouncer_explanation.D1: Same token and all conditions allow repeated suppression through exactly2.000s;2.001s expires and resets, no automatic re-arm.
debouncer_explanation.D2: A mismatched token returns false without clearing A even with other flags false; A may still suppress. A route change resets; reverting flags does not re-arm.
debouncer_explanation.D3_D4: For the armed token, stopped engine or changed format resets; flags are supplied synthetic predicate inputs, not an observed hardware timeline.

recorder_branches.synthetic_condition: AVAudioEngineConfigurationChange; active token/capture; not suppressed; four format fields unchanged

recorder_branches.boundary_note: Any one changed field fails format equality

recorder_branches.synthetic_condition: configureInputGraph or engine.start throws during configuration recovery
recorder_branches.boundary_note: arm happens before engine.start; failure resets expectation

recorder_branches.synthetic_condition: Valid routeChange reason oldDeviceUnavailable or noSuitableRouteForCategory
recorder_branches.boundary_note: Not the same branch as an engine configuration notification

recorder_branches.synthetic_condition: Interruption began or media services lost/reset
recorder_branches.boundary_note: Valid interruption ended is ignored by this observer; not an auto-resume instruction
Does not choose a mic or exclude a separate configuration notification

recorder_branches.synthetic_condition: Stale activeToken or recordingActive=false in observer task
recorder_branches.boundary_note: A token is correlation, not hardware or account authentication

recorder_branches.synthetic_condition: Short-voice capture completion failure while controller phase is recording
recorder_branches.boundary_note: Does not promise note-style partial audio saving; note recorder is a separate path

buyer_decision: Use the offline worked checks. Only separately authorized foreground capture: inspect own account, permissions/model/input and any existing draft; no blind duplicate insertion, Send or Run.
not_proven: actual microphone selection or accessory compatibility
App Store binary contains exact source recovery implementation
gap-free recording, saved partial audio or uninterrupted capture
ASR accuracy or real final transcript
